gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-belgrano: Belgrano is a classic serif whose curves stay open and unhurried, a traditional foil for Cowboys, which looks traced with a single pen tip. Long paragraphs feel steady.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-habibi: Cowboys draws rustic, authoritative letters with wide gaps between stems and no thick-to-thin shift at all. But Habibi is the one built for sustained text, its serif forms leading gently into each round shape.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-labrada: Cowboys looks like bent paperclip wire, with wide gaps between its stems and no swelling anywhere, set against the dignified text serif of Labrada. Together they feel rustic and bookish.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-montaga: Wide gaps between neighboring stems give Cowboys its rustic, laser-etched look, while Montaga stitches its text serif curves like thread along a path. Reading it feels bookish and unhurried.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-new-tegomin: Dignified is the first impression, thanks to New Tegomin and its wide-open ring of a c under the wire-weight lines of Cowboys. And the rustic heading and traditional body agree on a steady, authoritative tone.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-rhodium-libre: Every stroke in Cowboys carries the same visual weight, like a trace etched by laser, with generous gaps between the stems. And Rhodium Libre, a serif, lifts its brush ends away before each curve closes.
gen-dafont-dogica-fs-amulya: Dogica sets lowercase letters rising close to the capitals, spaced wide and heavy, so it earns its keep big and short. And Amulya, a sans, keeps its curve openings generous and modern underneath.
gen-dafont-dogica-plus-jakarta-sans: Heavy, wide, and loud. Dogica puts tall lowercase letters in generous tracking, while Plus Jakarta Sans, a sans-serif, stays monoline and precise, with curve endings held well apart beneath it.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-fs-plein: Playful and commanding, Early GameBoy stretches its tracking and lets its curves swell and taper gently. Plein follows with a reliable, clean build, each round letter entered through a clear channel.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-fs-synonym: Early GameBoy looks playful and commanding, with open tracking and strokes that differ just enough to feel alive. But Synonym, a sans, draws curves and straights at a single width, and that dependable uniformity is the strongest quality.
